text:
jordan: Heads-up — small-batch smoke showing alloc scaling oddity on canary. p95 up ~2x for 1–4k seq under batch_size=8. attaching microbench.
alyssa: Ugh. Which PR?
jordan: PR #9002 (alloc-scheduler refactor). Can reproduce locally with shardpack workload. Quick snippet of results:
```
bench: small-batch-4k
config: batch_horizon=8, max_alloc=32
throughput: 420 tok/s -> was 450 tok/s
p95 latency: 180ms -> was 95ms
rss: 10.9GB -> spike to 13.2GB
```
sam: that's pretty noisy. did you run with prefills? prefix cache warm?
jordan: prefills=on. reproduces cold and warm but tail much worse cold. attached flame (link) and bench artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/bench/4581234567
dina: can we try batch_horizon=4 and prefetch=false to see if horizon interacts?
jordan: ran that, results attached:
```
batch_horizon=4, prefetch=false
throughput: 438 tok/s
p95: 110ms
rss: 11.1GB
```
alyssa: seems like horizon=8 increased kv-shard concurrency and pushed allocs. might be allocator backpressure bug.
marc: assignable to who? I can take a quick look, but can't merge without 2 approvals.
jordan: tagged @marc and @dina in PR comments. Requesting quick eyes and perf signoff. Proposal: hold merge until canary runs 6h without p95 bump OR we revert scheduler change and ship incremental.
sam: also recommend running canary with quant kernel fallback to rule out kernel selection interaction.
ops-bot: Canary started for PR 9002 in region us-west-2 — canary id c-8841 :rocket:
marc: I pulled the flamegraph. culprit looks like async alloc in sharding path; small change possible. i'll open PR with mitigation and bench it tomorrow morning.
dina: nice. if marc's fix is small, can we ship as hotfix and rerun canary? need 2 approvals from eng-runtime.
jordan: bumping for approvals. :eyes:
alyssa: leaving one quick note on comment about max_alloc default.
marc: leaving my +1 for now, will add bench artifacts to PR once I run local microbench. need one more approval.
sam: +1 from me as long as canary passes overnight.
jordan: thanks all — holding merge until canary c-8841 completes and marc's followup PR posted.
marc: filed followup PR #9020 with allocator guard. linking bench: https://artifacts.internal/bench/9020
jordan: awesome. will re-run canary with guard in place. closing loop tomorrow.
ops-bot: Canary c-8841 completed — p95 stable. :white_check_mark:
jordan: merging window request for 02:30 UTC tomorrow. tagging release calendar.
marc: LGTM — merge when window opens. :thumbsup:
